title: Exercise 4: Sentence Transformation
instruction: Rewrite each sentence using the cue provided so that it has the closest meaning to the original sentence.
target_grammar: Verbs with prepositions, Relative clauses referring to a whole sentence

questions.original_sentence: The school installed an automatic light in each classroom. This significantly decreased electricity consumption.
questions.correct_answer: The school installed an automatic light in each classroom, which significantly decreased electricity consumption.
acceptable_answers: The school installed an automatic light in each classroom, which significantly decreased electricity consumption.
The school installed an automatic light in each classroom, which helped decrease electricity consumption.
questions.explanation: Dùng đại từ quan hệ ', which' thay thế cho toàn bộ sự việc lắp đèn tự động ở mệnh đề trước.

questions.original_sentence: People dump untreated plastic packaging into rivers. This causes severe harm to wild animals.
questions.correct_answer: People dump untreated plastic packaging into rivers, which causes severe harm to wild animals.
acceptable_answers: People dump untreated plastic packaging into rivers, which causes severe harm to wild animals.
People dump untreated plastic packaging into rivers, which harms wild animals.
questions.explanation: Kết hợp hai câu thành một bằng mệnh đề quan hệ ', which' để nêu hệ quả của hành vi vứt rác nhựa làm hại động vật hoang dã.

questions.original_sentence: The volunteers participated in cleaning up the polluted shoreline. This prevented plastic litter from drifting into the open ocean.
questions.correct_answer: The volunteers participated in cleaning up the polluted shoreline, which prevented plastic litter from drifting into the open ocean.
acceptable_answers: The volunteers participated in cleaning up the polluted shoreline, which prevented plastic litter from drifting into the open ocean.
The volunteers participated in cleaning up the polluted shoreline, which helped prevent plastic litter from drifting into the open ocean.
questions.explanation: Dùng ', which' thay cho toàn bộ nỗ lực dọn rác bờ biển của nhóm tình nguyện viên.

questions.original_sentence: Excessive burning of coal and fossil fuels leads to high greenhouse gas emissions.
questions.correct_answer: High greenhouse gas emissions result from excessive burning of coal and fossil fuels.
acceptable_answers: High greenhouse gas emissions result from excessive burning of coal and fossil fuels.
High greenhouse gas emissions result from the excessive burning of coal and fossil fuels.
questions.explanation: Chuyển từ 'lead to' (dẫn đến) sang 'result from' (bắt nguồn từ / do nguyên nhân gì gây ra).

questions.original_sentence: Dumping unsorted household waste into a landfill causes catastrophic soil and groundwater pollution.
questions.cue: Dumping unsorted household waste into a landfill results
questions.correct_answer: Dumping unsorted household waste into a landfill results in catastrophic soil and groundwater pollution.
acceptable_answers: Dumping unsorted household waste into a landfill results in catastrophic soil and groundwater pollution.
questions.explanation: Sử dụng cấu trúc 'result in sth' (gây ra, dẫn đến kết quả gì).

questions.original_sentence: Lan always carries a reusable bottle, a reusable cup, and a metal straw to school. This habit helps her reduce single-use plastic waste.
questions.cue: Lan always carries a reusable bottle, a reusable cup, and a metal straw to school,
questions.correct_answer: Lan always carries a reusable bottle, a reusable cup, and a metal straw to school, which helps her reduce single-use plastic waste.
acceptable_answers: Lan always carries a reusable bottle, a reusable cup, and a metal straw to school, which helps her reduce single-use plastic waste.
Lan always carries a reusable bottle, a reusable cup, and a metal straw to school, which helps reduce single-use plastic waste.
questions.explanation: Dùng đại từ ', which' thay cho thói quen mang bình nước, cốc dùng nhiều lần và ống hút kim loại đi học.

questions.original_sentence: The farming cooperative relies on organic compost instead of applying synthetic chemical fertiliser.
questions.correct_answer: The farming cooperative depends on organic compost instead of applying synthetic chemical fertiliser.
acceptable_answers: The farming cooperative depends on organic compost instead of applying synthetic chemical fertiliser.
questions.explanation: Thay thế động từ 'relies on' bằng 'depends on' (dựa vào / phụ thuộc vào).

questions.original_sentence: The eco-hotel began composting leftover kitchen scraps. This practice provides rich nutrient layers for organic gardens.
questions.correct_answer: The eco-hotel began composting leftover kitchen scraps, which provides rich nutrient layers for organic gardens.
acceptable_answers: The eco-hotel began composting leftover kitchen scraps, which provides rich nutrient layers for organic gardens.
questions.explanation: Dùng ', which' thay thế cho toàn bộ việc ủ thức ăn thừa của khách sạn sinh thái.

questions.original_sentence: You should not throw away a glass jar because you can easily reuse it as a charming plant pot.
questions.correct_answer: Instead of throwing away a glass jar, you can easily reuse it as a charming plant pot.
acceptable_answers: Instead of throwing away a glass jar, you can easily reuse it as a charming plant pot.
Instead of throwing a glass jar away, you can easily reuse it as a charming plant pot.
questions.explanation: Sau cụm giới từ 'Instead of' dùng danh động từ V-ing ('throwing away').

questions.original_sentence: Many urban residents do not care about how much electricity they waste each month.
questions.cue: Many urban residents pay no attention to
questions.correct_answer: Many urban residents pay no attention to how much electricity they waste each month.
acceptable_answers: Many urban residents pay no attention to how much electricity they waste each month.
Many urban residents pay no attention to their waste of electricity each month.
questions.explanation: Cụm 'pay no attention to' (không để ý đến) đồng nghĩa với 'do not care about'.
